stories.title: Patriots' Kraft on Macklemore: Won't provide platform for 'hate speech'
stories.summary: Robert Kraft said he had Macklemore removed as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's shows at Gillette Stadium due in part to a "history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery that we believe has been deeply offensive and hurtful to the Jewish community."

stories.title: Sources: Clippers, Raptors complete trade sending Leonard to Toronto
stories.summary: The trade sending Kawhi Leonard from L.A. to Toronto is now official after a months-long delay due to the investigation into the Clippers.

stories.title: Sources: Brees mulled NFL comeback, playing for Broncos in AFC title game
stories.summary: Broncos assistant coaches had discussions with Drew Brees about the former star QB coming out of retirement to play for Denver in last season's AFC Championship Game, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Eagles' Dickerson (knee) to IR, says he was 'complete liability' in opener
stories.summary: The Eagles are placing left guard Landon Dickerson on injured reserve because of a knee injury, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter, meaning he will miss at least the next four games.

stories.title: Sarkisian: Ohio St. should be rewarded for playing Texas
stories.summary: After a dramatic 24-23 comeback victory over then-No. 1 Ohio State, Texas coach Steve Sarkisian said the Buckeyes should be rewarded for playing a marquee matchup in a nonconference game.
